14.limitation: The plan's t14 acceptance literally says variant (b) 'dies at the host-match check'. It does not: in the VM's offline sandbox the app dies at its FIRST action, `nix eval` of the baked flake ('install: cannot evaluate the flake ...'), so the host-match guard is never reached. The landed test therefore pins the reachable observables (unit runs -> fails cleanly -> rescue target activates -> no disk write -> app started), not the specific failure reason. This is documented in the test header. Honest, but the host-match guard's runtime behaviour is NOT exercised by CI.
